description: A result is accepted only with an independent verifier's review and an approver's approval: a production origin key, an eligible review from the roster verifier and an eligible approval from the roster approver (different persons, different keys), the approval citing some valid verifier review (rule O does not require it to be the roster verifier's), no self-verification, v4 bundles only.

slots.name: originator-key
slots.means: the key id of the producer's production signing key (the key that signs the seal)

slots.name: verifier-key
slots.means: the key id the verifier signs sign-offs with

slots.name: verifier-signer-id
slots.means: the verifier's signer_id, exactly as their sign-offs carry it

slots.name: verifier-name
slots.means: the verifier's printed name, exactly as their sign-offs carry it

slots.name: approver-key
slots.means: the key id the approver signs sign-offs with

slots.name: approver-signer-id
slots.means: the approver's signer_id, exactly as their sign-offs carry it

slots.name: approver-name
slots.means: the approver's printed name, exactly as their sign-offs carry it

pins.label: producer production signing key
pins.replace_me: placeholder: replace key_id with the key id of the producer's production signing key, then delete this member (or: proof-policy init --fill originator-key=KEY)

roster.replace_me: placeholder: replace keys, signer_id and printed_name with the verifier's own key id, signer id and printed name exactly as their sign-offs carry them, then delete this member (or: proof-policy init --fill verifier-key=KEY --fill verifier-signer-id=ID --fill verifier-name=NAME)

placeholder: replace keys, signer_id and printed_name with the approver's own key id, signer id and printed name exactly as their sign-offs carry them, then delete this member (or: proof-policy init --fill approver-key=KEY --fill approver-signer-id=ID --fill approver-name=NAME)
